supports.quote: I'm worried our onboarding emails are annoying people. we send five in the first week and the unsubscribe rate keeps going up. marketing loves them though. I don't want to kill them entirely, I just don't want new users to feel spammed.

framings.text: The onboarding program may be overloading new users: five emails in the first week coincide with a rising unsubscribe rate, while marketing values the emails. The aim is to preserve onboarding without making new users feel spammed.

board.outcome: New users feel welcomed rather than spammed; onboarding emails remain available rather than being eliminated, while the rising unsubscribe rate is reduced.

questions.text: Should the five first-week emails be reduced, or should they remain while their timing or content changes?
